tagline: A raised, ventilated shelter that keeps your dog off the damp grass on garden days.
lead: Your dog gets a sheltered spot of their own in the garden, raised clear of the damp grass.
value: Everything garden days need is built in: a raised floor off the damp, a ventilated shell and a shaped doorway that helps shed rain.
intro: Bothy is a plastic garden dog house with a raised floor, a ventilated shell and an arched doorway. It is a garden addition for supervised days outside, not a replacement for indoor housing. Bedding is not included.
points: The raised floor keeps them clear of damp grass.
A sloped shell and arched doorway help water run off.
Ventilation in the shell lets air pass through the house.
The plastic wipes clean with a damp cloth and mild soap.
best_for: Dogs who like a sheltered spot on supervised garden days. Give them water and safe shade, and bring them indoors in extreme weather: a kennel won't stop overheating.
fit_note: Ask us for the internal floor, doorway and supported load measurements before ordering. Your dog should be able to walk in, stand, turn round and lie down comfortably inside.
care: Wipe the shell with a damp cloth and mild soap. Follow the separate care label for any cushion you add, store soft furnishings under cover, and let everything dry before use.
seo_title: Raised Floor Plastic Dog House for the Garden | Snoozly
seo_description: A garden dog house that lifts your dog off damp grass. Raised floor, ventilated plastic shell and an arched doorway that helps shed rain. Wipes clean.
